html:
Question 7
?

Consider the standard basis {i,j} of R2. If T is a linear transformation such that T(i)=12i and T(j)=j, then what is the geometric interpretation of the transformation T?

a
A stretch of scale factor 2 in the x-direction
b
A stretch of scale factor 12 in the x-direction
c
A stretch of scale factor 12 in the y-direction
d
A vertical shear with a shear factor of 12
e
A horizontal shear with a shear factor of 12
Submit
